overview_description.description: Acko is a digital insurance company that provides a range of general insurance products through a direct-to-consumer model. The company offers services including motor insurance, health insurance, and employee group health coverage. Acko operates with a technology-driven approach, utilizing data analytics and digital platforms to streamline the purchase, management, and claims process for policyholders. Its motor insurance policies cover private vehicles and two-wheelers, with services such as instant policy issuance and paperless claims. In health insurance, Acko provides personalized plans with features like zero waiting period and flexible benefits. For businesses, Acko delivers group health insurance solutions with digital onboarding, claims support, and wellness programs for employees. The company partners with platforms in sectors such as e-commerce, mobility, and travel to distribute its embedded insurance products.

product.name: Health Insurance

product.name: Travel Insurance

product.name: Life Insurance
